title: Law to add nonprofit swim programs to city pool map
summary: This bill would require the Parks Department to identify which public pools could host swimming and water safety programs run by not-for-profit organizations, and to list those pools and programs on its existing online interactive pool map. If a pool is found not suitable for such programming, Parks must report to the mayor and Council by May 1, 2027 explaining why and recommending ways to improve access. The law would take effect 90 days after enactment.
